notes.title: Info for players on older Mac models (pre Metal era Macs)
notes.content:
If your Mac is older than 2015 then there is a high chance it is not supporting Apple's graphics API metal. We have provided an Open GL branch for you. In your Steam Library, right click on Tengami and select [b]Properties[/b]. Go to the [b]Betas[/b] tab and select the "Open GL" branch. In your Steam library the game is now called "Tengami (opengl)". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7259055/dc0d5d04f27ba0f4520cd024b454303551dbe097.jpg[/img]

If you need further help please email contact@nyamyam.com

notes.title: Metal support for Mac version
notes.content: This is primarily a maintenannce and performance update. Improved texture performance on all plattforms. Updated to the most recent version of Wwise (audio middleware). Mac is now fully using Metal to comply with Apple deprecating Open GL on their platforms.

notes.title: Catalina support
notes.content:
With this update Tengami fully supports Mac OS Catalina, the 64-bit Mac app requirement and notarisation. We have also optimised the game further reducing the download size by half and enabled full retina support. 

If you encounter any issues please get in touch via forum or email: contact@nyamyam.com

notes.title: Shakespearean Shenanigans
notes.content:
We teamed up with our friends from Kitfox and Golden Glitch to bring you the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13521/Shakespearean_Shenanigans/]Shakespearean Shenanigan's bundle[/url]. Get Astrologaster, Elsinore and Fit For a King at a discount. It is a complete the set type of bundle, so if you already have one ore more of these games you can still the remaining with discount.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13521/Shakespearean_Shenanigans/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33063242/04752051dde37dd617a30d5ccee73cb01c4bbf1b.jpg[/img][/url]

Visit merry olde England... or at least 3 different, thoroughly silly interpretations thereof, which may or may not be educational. From prophecies to proposals and stargazings to soliloquys, there's no shortage of comedic possibilities in these indie gems.

Try:
Elsinore - a time-looping adventure game set in the world of Shakespeare's Hamlet! Play as Ophelia living through the four days of a doomed castle again and again.

Astrologaster - a ridiculous story of treating patients in Elizabethan England using the best medicine: astrology!

Fit For a King - rule with impunity and marry, imprison, or execute just about anyone and everything you please in this extremely accurate simulation of 1500s royal life.

notes.title: Vote for Astrologaster in the IGF Audience Award
notes.content:
Astrologaster is nominated in the "Excellence in Audio" category at this year's Independent Games Festival. Huzzah! Huzzah! Huzzah!

Astrologaster got honourable mentions in 3 more categories: Excellence in Narrative, Nuovo and Grand Prize.

The IGF has an audience award. It would mean a lot to everyone who made the game if you would give us a vote. There is no lengthy sign-up process or anything involved. Just select "Astrologaster" from the top of the list, enter your email address and hit submit. All email addressed will be deleted once the voting ends. Thank you!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33063242/0a322b6d7ed80de370046ea313ee74d403a58dd0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Introducing Astrologaster
notes.content:
We recently released our new game Astrologaster on Steam. Astrologaster is a comedy game set in Shakespeare's London. You take on the role of 'Doctor' Simon Forman and treat his patients using Astrology. The London medical establishment is calling 'Doctor' Forman out on his methods. Can you help him win a medical licence and proof these doubters wrong? Astrologaster is based on a true story and SImon Forman is a real historic figure. It is currently 15% off in the Steam summer sale. 


Like Tengami, Astrologaster takes place inside a "pop-up book" to bring the casebooks of this notorious Astrologer come to life. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/742520/

This is what the press had to say so far:

[quote="Rock, Paper, Shotgun"]It’s a story reminiscent of Blackadder, dripping with sarcasm, theatrical and funny.[/quote]

[quote="The Guardian"]Astrologaster is bawdy biographical fiction told through medical quandaries and humorous choral music, all the more entertaining because it’s based on things that actually happened. - 4/5[/quote]

[quote=Edge]Edge Magazine Jun 20, 2019 80 For all the gags, Astrologaster is a romp with no little substance. [Issue#334, p.120] - 8/10[/quote]

notes.title: Tengami v1.0.4
notes.content:
Updated to latest version of WWise and fixed sound crackling issues.
Updated to latest version of SDL.
Improved frame rate consistency for high frequency monitors.

Known issue:
Switching between window mode and fullscreen during play can cause some issues on some cards. Please restart the game after making changes to be safe.



Please keep reporting any issues you encounter with the game, so we can keep on improving support. Many thanks.

notes.title: Tengami v1.0.2
notes.content:
We just uploaded a new version of Tengami to Steam. 

Here is the list of changes:

[list][*] Version number is displayed in the 'Settings' so you know whether your game is up-to-date.
[*] Enhanced error reporting to help people who have issue launching the game locating the problem. This can be a variety of issues with graphics card drivers. Please report the errors in our forum for further assistance. It is our aim to eventually fix most of the issues from within the game. 
[*] Added support for Steam error reporting, so we can look at the issues in more detail.[/list]

notes.title: Bug Update - 17/01/2014
notes.content:
First of all massive thanks to the community for reporting issues with the game and helping us to troubleshoot them. Thanks to everyone's collaboration we were able to resolve some issues and make progress on others.

[b]Save Game - Resolved [/b]
There was an issue with the game not saving correctly through Steam Cloud for some people. We believe that of this morning the issue is fixed and the game should save correctly for everyone now. Please note that the game uses an auto save system. Once you back to the game's main menu there should be an option 'Continue Game' is you have saved progress.

[b] No mouse input - Resolved[/b]
If the game is unresponsive to mouse input then you probably don't have VSync enabled. This is a setting in your graphics card driver . You can enable this through the Graphics setting in the Control Center. We are looking into forcing VSync from within the game, so no one has to change this manually in the future. It might also be worth updating your graphics card driver.

[b]Game doesn't launch  - Work in progress[/b]
This is a bit of an odd issue, that a quick google search revealed is a mysterious issue for quite a few games.  The main problem here seems to be a missing / corrupt / inaccessible MSVCP110.dll This file is usually part of Windows and is used by many programs. As a first step we have included the 'VS Studio 2012 - Distribution' as part of the game install. From what I understand this should be done by Steam automatically and not require any kind of manual install. Even with a re-install of the DLL the game still does not launch for a small number of people. We keep investigating the reasons for this. 

[b]Sound dropping - Work in Progress[/b]
The music seems to be cutting out for some people. We are still looking into the reasons for this.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Tengami, 25% off!
notes.content:
Tengami is Now Available on Steam and is 25% off!*

Tengami is an atmospheric adventure game set inside a Japanese pop-up book. Fold and slide the beautifully crafted paper world to solve puzzles and discover secrets.

*Offer ends January 22 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Tengami coming to Steam on January 15th
notes.content:
On January 15th, Tengami will finally be released on Steam. As you might be aware we previously released it on iOS and the Wii U eShop and are very excited to share our atmospheric pop-up book game with more players.

Tengami will be sold for US-$9.99, EURO 7.99, GBP 6.99 and equivalent. During launch week the game will be 25% off.

Tengami supports Steam Achievements, as well as cloud save. We are looking to add Trading Cards at a later point.

Minimum PC requirements
OS: Windows Vista
Processor: Core 2 Duo
Memory: 2 GB RAM
Graphics: Open GL 2.1 compatible graphics card
Hard Drive: 900 MB available space

The download size is around 384 MB and the installed game will take up around 810 MB.

Minimum Mac requirements
OS: Mountain Lion
Processor: Core 2 Duo
Memory: 2 GB RAM
Graphics: Open GL 2.1 compatible graphics card
Hard Drive: 500 MB available space

The download size is around 455 MB and the installed game will take up around 490 MB.
